newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Eng, Kukdong end limit up.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Eng, Kukdong end limit up.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Engineering Co and Kukdong City Gas Co Ltd ended their first day of trading at their upper limits, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
Samsung, a unit of the Samsung Group, ended at 43,200 won, up 3,200 from its base price.
Samsung's initial public offering was 23,000 won.
Kukdong closed trading at 37,800 won, 2,800 higher. Its IPO subscription price was 22,000 won.
The base price is the weighted average of bids and offers received by the exchange and sets the trading range for the first trading day.
The shares of Sindoricoh Co Ltd, an office equipment maker, went limit down to close at 47,900 won, 4,100 lower. Their IPO subscription price was 39,000 won.
Kuk Dong Corp's shares ended at 16,800 won, down 1,200, against an IPO price of 15,000 won.
Furniture maker Fursys Inc stock finished 3,200 won lower at 38,000. Its IPO had been set at 35,000.
Sewon Chemical Co Ltd's shares ended at 21,900, up 400, against an IPO price of 18,000 won.
Dong Nam Chemical Industries Co Ltd closed down 1,600 won at their lower limit of 18,400. The stock's IPO had been set at 15,000.
Muhak Alcohol Co Ltd's ended at 19,300 won, up 1,300, against an IPO price of 14,000.
